questions: What is the exact 'past period' for which the time series data should be generated? (e.g., last 30 days, last 7 days, last year)
How many data points should be generated for the time series? (e.g., 30 points, one per day)
Should the 'Date' x-axis values be generated as daily intervals, hourly, or some other frequency?
Should the plot include a legend? The prompt mentions 'label' in reference code but not in spec.
Is the random integer generation inclusive of both 0 and 100? (Clarification says 'between 0 and 100 inclusive', but 'between' is ambiguous.)
What should happen if the seed parameter is None? Should it default to 42 or disable seeding?
Should the function set the global matplotlib rcParams for font family to Arial, or only apply it to this plot?
Is the ValueError raised for any Exception, or only specific issues? The spec says 'issue generating the data or plot', but reference catches any Exception.
